# UI prototype

Use this branch for screens, components, layouts, interaction models, and visual direction.

## Shape

Prefer several meaningfully different variants that can be compared in one place.

Use the host project's normal routing or component conventions. Do not invent a new app structure unless the project has none.

## Requirements

- One route, story, or command to view the variants.
- A simple way to switch variants.
- Clearly labeled prototype-only code.
- Realistic placeholder content when actual data is unavailable.
- No production polish beyond what is needed to judge the idea.

## Variants

Create variants that test different product or interaction hypotheses, not tiny styling differences.

Good variant axes:

- Information hierarchy.
- Navigation model.
- Density.
- Progressive disclosure.
- Empty/loading/error states.
- Mobile vs desktop emphasis.

## Finish

Capture the chosen direction and why. Update the relevant issue, living doc, or ADR if the choice has durable consequences. Delete or absorb the prototype code.
